variants.notes: The template docx has exactly ONE repeatable fee-table row - not capped at any fixed count. Supply a `components` list with one entry per REAL component the user described (2, 3, 5, however many); DocTemplateEngine clones the template row once per entry and discards the original. Each entry has `label` (a short name for the component, e.g. 'Referral Fee') and `terms` (ONE free-text line fully composed by the AI from what the user actually said). `example_terms` above are PATTERNS to guide phrasing/structure when a component matches one of these common shapes (flat amount, percentage/commission, cost-share split with a partner, a non-Client payer entity, hourly overage) - fill in the {{...}} slots in whichever pattern fits from what the user described, keeping the surrounding wording. They are illustrative, not exhaustive and not a closed enum: a genuinely different arrangement the user describes should be composed as its own free-text line in the same natural, contract-appropriate register, not forced into the nearest example if it doesn't actually fit. Either way, `terms` is not restricted to a fixed sub-shape (no separate rigid amount/percentage/payer fields) - but every fact inside it, whether following an example pattern or freely composed, must come from the conversation, never invented. Never pad the `components` list with an invented entry to hit some expected count, and never merge two real components into one to reduce the count - REQ-083-02 forbids inventing OR collapsing data either way, and applies with equal force to inventing/omitting a detail WITHIN one component's `terms` line.
